parameters.name: GroupType
parameters.description:
The type of instances managed by the scaling group. Valid values:

- ECS: The scaling group manages ECS instances.

- ECI: The scaling group manages ECI instances.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the scaling group list. Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page for paging queries. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the scaling group.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which the scaling group belongs.
>If no scaling group belongs to the specified resource group, an empty result is returned, and no error is returned.

parameters.name: ScalingGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the scaling group to query. ScalingGroupId.N specifies the Nth scaling group ID. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. Invalid scaling group IDs are ignored in the query results, and no error is returned.

parameters.name: ScalingGroupName
parameters.description: The name of the scaling group.
